page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4g.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For storage-intensive workloads, the instance includes 7679 GB of local SSD storage. This bundled high-capacity local storage is integrated directly into the hardware profile. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfer rates for distributed environments.

The combination of a high vCPU count, balanced memory-to-core ratio, and substantial local SSD storage makes this instance highly resource-dense. It offers qualitative cost efficiency for deployments requiring large-scale local data processing without the overhead of external storage attachments. This server is designed for workloads such as large relational databases, NoSQL data stores, data warehousing, and high-throughput transactional applications.
